plugin.name: Subnautica & Below Zero Play
plugin.description: Let N.E.K.O play Subnautica and Subnautica: Below Zero: open the game yourself and load a save, then the catgirl watches the screen, explains her plan, explores and gathers, uses the PDA/fabricator/builder with clicks, and tries to advance the story. Take over at any time; F9 or 'stop' hands the keyboard back.
